ops.text: cc-notes sync --remote origin fails from non-interactive sessions in cc-pane: the underlying `git push origin refs/cc-notes/*` hits "could not read Username for 'https://github.com': Device not configured" — the https remote has no usable credential helper in this context, and `gh auth setup-git` did not fix it (the push subprocess still can't read credentials). The PostToolUse hook's suggested retry is a dead end here; claims stay local until an interactive session (or an SSH remote) pushes the refs.
